hypotheses.H0_all_head_program_recomposes_near4_qv: The masked all-head recurrence matches the ordinary near-four Q+V recurrence within 1e-5 and the all-head local role derivative matches native selected roles within 1e-5.
hypotheses.H1_head_importance_is_context_stable: Leave-one-head-out importance over 36 layer-head invocations has discovery/evaluation Spearman correlation at least 0.50.
hypotheses.H2_top8_heads_are_behaviorally_sufficien: The frozen top-eight invocation program is within 0.10 causal fidelity of all 36 heads for every target on held-out contexts.
hypotheses.H3_top8_heads_beat_random: The frozen top-eight program exceeds the matched random-eight program by at least 0.10 for every target.
hypotheses.H4_top16_heads_are_behaviorally_sufficie: The frozen top-sixteen program is within 0.05 of all heads for every target.
hypotheses.H5_selected_heads_span_multiple_layers: The frozen top-eight set contains heads from at least three of the four role layers.
hypotheses.H6_native_head_sparsity_is_supported: H1, H2, H3, and H5 all hold.
